name: @alconite/contract-guard-action
description: GitHub Action for Alconite Contract Guard release checks

scripts.build: npm run build:contract-guard && npm run build:runtime-verify && npm run build:impact
scripts.test: npm run build:test && node --test build/test/*.test.js build/test/runtime-verify/*.test.js test/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run validate:actions && npm run validate:dependencies && npm run validate:release && npm run build
